title: Weather Work Limits for Installation Jobs
content:
Exterior sealing, ladder work and large-unit work on **Installation Jobs** are done only within these forecast limits. A crew day forecast outside them is moved for weather.

| Installation method | Lowest forecast temperature for exterior sealing (°F) | Highest sustained forecast wind for ladder and large-unit work (mph) | Weather reschedule carries neither a fee nor a credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 40 | 25 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation | 40 | 25 | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 40 | 25 | Yes |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 40 | 25 | Yes |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 40 | 25 | Yes |
| Door System Installation | 40 | 25 | Yes |

## Reading the limits

- **Temperature.** Exterior sealing is done at a forecast of 40 °F or warmer. Below 40 °F the crew day is moved for weather.
- **Wind.** Ladder and large-unit work is done at a sustained forecast wind of 25 mph or less. Above 25 mph the crew day is moved for weather.
- **Charges.** Under every method, a crew day moved for weather carries no fee to the customer and no credit from Ridgeline.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical forecasts)

| Forecast | Within the limits? |
|---|---|
| 40 °F, wind 25 mph | Yes: at the lowest temperature and at the highest wind |
| 39 °F, wind 10 mph | No: below the lowest temperature |
| 55 °F, wind 26 mph | No: above the highest wind |
